verses.text: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

segments.text: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

verses.text: There on the willows we hung our harps,

segments.text: There on the willows we hung our harps,

verses.text: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”

segments.text: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”

verses.text: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?

segments.text: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?

verses.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.

segments.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.

verses.text: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!

segments.text: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!

verses.text: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”

segments.text: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”

verses.text: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.

segments.text: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.

verses.text: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

segments.text: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
